post.description: Uses the items currently in the authenticated user's active cart. The cart is cleared on success. For payment_method=stripe_checkout the order is created with status awaiting_payment and should be finalized via POST /api/payments/stripe/checkout-session.

post.summary: Create a Stripe Checkout session for an existing order
post.description: Creates a Stripe-hosted checkout session for an order previously created with payment_method=stripe_checkout. The client should open checkout_url in a WebView/browser.

message.example: Checkout session created. Open checkout_url in your WebView.

post.summary: Stripe webhook endpoint (not for direct client use)
post.description: Receives Stripe event notifications (e.g. checkout.session.completed, payment_intent events) used to keep order/payment status in sync. The request must be sent by Stripe with a valid Stripe-Signature header verified against the configured webhook secret; this endpoint is not called by the mobile client.

requestBody.description: Stripe's raw event payload (see Stripe webhook documentation)

500.description: Webhook not configured, or handler error
